claims.object_text: GAP toward rags 1 protein complex that inhibits mTORC1 activity
claims.quote: NPRL3 is a component of the GAP activity toward rags 1 protein complex that inhibits mammalian target of rapamycin complex 1 (mTORC1) activity

claims.object_text: familial focal cortical dysplasia and familial focal epilepsy
claims.quote: NPRL3 is a component of the GAP activity toward rags 1 protein complex that inhibits mammalian target of rapamycin complex 1 (mTORC1) activity and it is found mutated in familial focal cortical dysplasia and familial focal epilepsy.
CAGE tags represent an alternative TSS identifying TAGNPRL3 messenger RNAs (mRNAs).

claims.quote: TAGNPRL3 is expressed in red blood cells both at mRNA and protein levels
